name: Unified Med-VLM Benchmark
intro: Unified Med-VLM Benchmark 是 MedXiaohe 报告中的统一医疗视觉语言评测，用于比较医疗多模态模型能力。
build_method: 统一30多个公共与内部医疗benchmark的提示、输出格式和官方指标，引入临床忠实度评估
metric: Constituent official metrics and in-house faithfulness scores
eval_feature: 多模态, 临床忠实度, 多任务分层评估
scale: 30多个公共与内部benchmark，6类医疗能力
build_method_en: Unified prompts, output formats, and official metrics for more than 30 public and in-house medical benchmarks with faithfulness auditing
eval_feature_en: Multimodal, Clinical Faithfulness, Multi-family Layered Evaluation
intro_en: Unified Med-VLM Benchmark is a unified medical vision-language benchmark in MedXiaohe reports for comparing medical multimodal model capability across 6 capability families.
scale_en: More than 30 public and in-house benchmarks across 6 medical capability families
metric_en: Constituent official metrics and in-house faithfulness scores

drawio_review_note: Aligned with MedXIAOHE arXiv:2602.12705, Unified Evaluation section and main benchmark table. The Unified Med-VLM Benchmark is an evaluation suite defined in the MedXIAOHE technical report rather than a standalone dataset. It harmonizes more than 30 public and in-house benchmarks across visual diagnosis and recognition, medical imaging, diagnosis, medical text, report generation, and instruction following. The report standardizes prompts and output formats, uses structured outputs where appropriate, applies each constituent benchmark's official metric, and adds in-house faithfulness tests where report evaluation is sensitive to omissions versus unsupported additions. Models run under the same protocol and results are grouped by capability rather than collapsed into an undocumented single score.
